28.2.13676358.tested_on: ARM64 PRoot Debian real physical Android 16 device
28.2.13676358.notes: SUPERSEDES the earlier 'do not use' guidance below — kept for history, not because it is still accurate. Original finding: direct Flutter/Gradle selection failed at stripDebugDebugSymbols because the bundled linux-x86_64 llvm-strip host executable could not be started (environment-specific host-tool execution limitation, not a universal NDK 28/Android ARM64 incompatibility). Fixed 2026-09-01 by running `./setup.sh install-ndk 28.2.13676358`, which overwrites the bundled llvm-strip (via the existing llvm-strip->llvm-objcopy symlink, same structure as 27.2.12479018's fix) with a shim delegating to the system's real ARM64 llvm-strip. Re-tested end to end with the project temporarily pinned to this version: `./gradlew clean assembleDebug --no-daemon` succeeded including stripDebugDebugSymbols, APK installed via ADB, primaryCpuAbi=arm64-v8a, app launched (PID observed), and a crash/ANR logcat scan was clean. The project's canonical pin was then reverted back to 27.2.12479018 (re-confirmed still builds clean) — this version is a validated *option*, not the new default. `./setup.sh doctor` reports this version's llvm-strip as OK.
